explication: Vert.x Core is a low-level asynchronous application runtime and networking toolkit. An application creates a Vert.x instance, deploys verticles, and uses its APIs for messaging, networking, and file access; the runtime coordinates deployment and context-bound asynchronous work. The README explicitly names HTTP, TCP, and filesystem support, while the tree also exposes event bus, DNS, datagram, TLS, buffers, and logging subsystems. Several connections below are documented at product level; unsampled implementation wiring is left unasserted.
